decision.summaryForCoordinator: The strongest charge available here is that the artifact sets OBL-G08-HARNESS-SPEC leftoverDesign false while the source field it cites is named leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded — accepted AND recorded — and the recording has not happened. It fails on the source's own text and on precedent. G08 v2's failsIf[0] forbids closure 'by this file existing without independent ACCEPT and a later D-000 recording'; the forbidden move is closure by existence, and the subject cites an independent ACCEPT at 0/0 and names the outstanding recording limb in the same sentence, then keeps the discharge open in the qualificationAtNamedGate bucket, in doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone, and in proposedLaterWork. The accepted DR-112 sibling uses the identical construction near word-for-word. A method note worth passing on: the two fields the artifact leans on hardest, leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded and leftoverNameNote, are not top-level keys of G08 v2 — both sit under /whatThisCloses, and a shallow scan reports them absent and manufactures a confident blocker. Read at the right depth, both say exactly what the subject says, including the recorded gap 'No leftover-join artifact for this gate exists', which is why this file exists. On reserved numbers the decisive test is arithmetic rather than prose: the complete bare-integer set is 1, 5, 08 and 26, so no quorum cardinality, freshness floor, emergency threshold or waiver duration is present because no number is available to be one, and OD-112-1..OD-112-4 is named as a range with no values reproduced.
